exercises.q: My brother ____ work on Saturdays.
____ the train leave at 8:15?
exercises.why: The train = it, so use Does.

exercises.q: I ____ to the gym three times a week.
exercises.why: Habit with I: base verb, no -s.

exercises.q: Choose the correct sentence:
exercises.why: After doesn't, the verb has no -s.

exercises.q: He ____ his email every morning.
My manager ____ (not/work) from home on Fridays.
The server ____ (restart) every night at midnight.
____ your team use Slack at work? (do / does)
exercises.why: Your team is singular (it), so does.

exercises.q: She ____ (watch) the news every evening.
Eu não bebo café à noite.
exercises.ans: I don't drink coffee at night.

exercises.q: Ela trabalha para uma empresa de TI.
exercises.ans: She works for an IT company.
exercises.why: She + works; an before a vowel sound (eye-tee).

exercises.q: A que horas você acorda?
exercises.ans: What time do you wake up?
exercises.why: Question word + do + subject + base verb.

exercises.q: She ____ not at home today.
____ your parents at the airport?
I ____ 30 years old.
exercises.why: English uses be for age, not have (common mistake).

exercises.q: Choose the correct sentence:
exercises.why: English needs the subject 'It' for weather.

exercises.q: We ____ late for the meeting. Sorry!
There ____ a meeting at 3 p.m. today. (is / are)
My colleagues ____ very friendly.
How old ____ your daughter?
I ____ not ready yet. (am / is / are)
Eles não estão no escritório.
exercises.ans: They are not in the office.

exercises.q: Está muito quente hoje.
Quantos anos você tem?
exercises.why: Age uses be: How old are you?

exercises.q: She wants to be ____ doctor.
exercises.why: Jobs take a/an; doctor starts with a consonant sound.

exercises.q: I usually go to work by ____ bus.
____ life is short.
He works for ____ European company.
exercises.why: European starts with a /y/ sound, so a.

exercises.q: Can you close ____ window, please? It's cold.
I have ____ hour before the meeting. (a / an)
exercises.why: Hour starts with a vowel sound (silent h).

exercises.q: My sister is ____ university student. (a / an)
exercises.why: University starts with a /y/ sound, so a.

exercises.q: She plays ____ guitar very well. (a / the)
There is ____ umbrella under the desk. (a / an)
exercises.why: Umbrella starts with a vowel sound.

exercises.q: Ele é um engenheiro de software.
Eu preciso de um guarda-chuva.
Eu gosto de música clássica.
She ____ the meeting because she was sick.
I ____ my keys at the hotel yesterday.
____ you see the game last night?
exercises.why: Past questions use Did + base verb.

exercises.q: Choose the correct sentence:
exercises.why: After didn't, use the base form.

exercises.q: We ____ for two hours at the airport last Sunday.
They ____ (take) a taxi to the hotel.
Last year I ____ (not/travel) abroad.
____ he finish the project on time? (do / did)
She ____ (write) the report in an hour.
Eu não dormi bem ontem à noite.
exercises.ans: I did not sleep well last night.

exercises.q: Nós chegamos atrasados.
O que você comeu no almoço?
exercises.ans: What did you eat for lunch?
exercises.why: Question word + did + subject + base verb.

exercises.q: I ____ my parents this weekend. I already bought the tickets.
exercises.why: A decision already made uses going to.

exercises.q: I'm cold. - I ____ close the window.
Choose the correct sentence:
opts: I will to call you later.
I going to call you later.

exercises.q: She ____ have a baby in June. She told us yesterday.
exercises.why: A plan already decided: going to.

exercises.q: Don't worry, I promise I ____ tell anyone.
Use will: I'm sure you ____ (like) the new restaurant.
Use going to: Look at the sky! It ____ (snow).
Use going to: I ____ (not/accept) that job offer. I've decided.
exercises.why: Decision made: am not going to.

exercises.q: Use will: Don't worry, I ____ (send) you the file in five minutes.
Eu vou viajar para Lisboa no mês que vem.
exercises.ans: I am going to travel to Lisbon next month.
exercises.why: Plan: am going to + base verb.

exercises.q: Eu não vou me atrasar, prometo.
exercises.ans: I will not be late, I promise.

exercises.q: O que você vai fazer neste fim de semana?
exercises.ans: What are you going to do this weekend?
exercises.why: Question: What are you going to + verb?

exercises.q: My new job is ____ than my old one.
exercises.why: Long adjectives: more + adjective (than is already in the sentence).

exercises.q: She is ____ student in the class.
exercises.why: Superlative of long adjectives: the most + adjective.

exercises.q: Choose the correct sentence:
opts: He is more tall than me.
He is more taller than me.

exercises.q: This is ____ hotel I've ever stayed in.
The new software is not ____ the old one.
Today is ____ (hot) than yesterday.
Brazil is the ____ (big) country in South America.
This exercise is ____ (easy) than the last one.
Walking is not as ____ (fast) as driving.
exercises.why: as + adjective + as uses the basic form.

exercises.q: Meu escritório é maior do que o seu.
exercises.ans: My office is bigger than yours.

exercises.q: Este é o restaurante mais caro da cidade.
exercises.ans: This is the most expensive restaurant in the city.
exercises.why: the most + long adjective; in the city.

exercises.q: Voar é mais rápido do que dirigir.
I ____ my manager yesterday.
We ____ each other for ten years.
exercises.why: Unfinished period with for: present perfect.

exercises.q: Choose the correct sentence:
opts: I have lost my phone, so I can't call you.
I have lost my phone yesterday.
exercises.why: Present result, no finished time: present perfect.

exercises.q: ____ you ever been to a conference abroad?
exercises.why: Life experience: Have you ever been...?

exercises.q: They have ____ the project, so we can start testing.
I ____ (never/eat) Japanese food.
We ____ (already/send) the invoice.
He ____ (be) to Paris twice.
She hasn't ____ (answer) my email yet.
Nós ainda não recebemos a resposta.
exercises.ans: We have not received the answer yet.

exercises.q: Ela já fez o check-in.
Eu perdi minhas chaves.
exercises.why: Present result of a past action.

exercises.q: She ____ for the exam all week.
exercises.why: Activity up to now: has been + -ing.

exercises.q: I ____ for you for an hour!
exercises.why: Duration with for: have been waiting.

exercises.q: The kids are dirty because they ____ in the garden.
exercises.why: Recent activity with a visible result.

exercises.q: Choose the correct sentence:
opts: I have been working here since 2021.
I have been work here since 2021.
exercises.why: since + point in time needs present perfect continuous.

exercises.q: He ____ three coffees today.
exercises.why: A counted, completed quantity uses present perfect simple.

exercises.q: We ____ (try) to fix this bug since morning.
She is tired because she ____ (run).
It ____ (snow) all night, and the roads are closed.
I ____ (not/sleep) well lately.
Eu estou trabalhando neste projeto desde janeiro.
exercises.ans: I have been working on this project since January.
exercises.why: Work on a project; since + starting point.

exercises.q: Ela tem estudado alemão por seis meses.
exercises.ans: She has been studying German for six months.

exercises.q: O que você tem feito ultimamente?
exercises.ans: What have you been doing lately?

exercises.q: I ____ dinner when you called.
They ____ when the fire alarm rang.
At 8 p.m. yesterday, we ____ the final presentation.
exercises.why: Action in progress at a specific past time.

exercises.q: Choose the correct sentence:
opts: She was talk on the phone.
She were talking on the phone.
She was talking on the phone.

exercises.q: The phone rang while I ____ a shower.
exercises.why: I + was + -ing for the longer background action.

exercises.q: I ____ (drive) home when I saw the accident.
They ____ (not/pay) attention during the training.
____ it raining when you left? (was / were)
While we ____ (wait) for the flight, we had dinner.
Eu estava dormindo quando o alarme tocou.
exercises.ans: I was sleeping when the alarm rang.

exercises.q: Nós estávamos trabalhando quando a luz acabou.
exercises.ans: We were working when the power went out.

exercises.q: O que você estava fazendo na sexta-feira à noite?
exercises.ans: What were you doing on Friday night?

exercises.q: When I got to the office, the meeting ____.
He ____ never flown before that trip.
exercises.why: Before a past point: had never flown.

exercises.q: After they ____ dinner, they went for a walk.
Choose the correct sentence:
opts: I had went home before it rained.
I had gone home before it rained.
I have gone home before it rained.
I had go home before it rained.

exercises.q: By 6 p.m., the team ____ all the tests.
The plane ____ (already/leave) when we reached the gate.
I ____ (never/hear) that song before yesterday.
She was happy because she ____ (pass) the interview.
We didn't have any food because we ____ (not/go) shopping.
Quando cheguei, ele já tinha saído.
exercises.ans: When I arrived, he had already left.

exercises.q: Eu tinha trabalhado lá por cinco anos antes de me mudar.
exercises.ans: I had worked there for five years before I moved.
exercises.why: Earlier period in the past: had worked.

exercises.q: Ela me disse que já tinha comido.
exercises.ans: She told me she had already eaten.
exercises.why: Reported speech shifts to past perfect.

exercises.q: I ____ eat meat, but now I'm a vegetarian.
exercises.why: Past habit that stopped: used to.

exercises.q: When I was a child, I ____ afraid of dogs.
exercises.why: Past states need used to, not would.

exercises.q: Did you ____ live in Rio?
exercises.why: After did, the form is use to.

exercises.q: Choose the correct sentence:
opts: I am used to wake up early.
I'm used to waking up early.
I used to waking up early.
I use to wake up early.
exercises.why: be used to + verb-ing means you are accustomed.

exercises.q: Every summer, we ____ go to my grandparents' farm.
exercises.why: Repeated past action: would is possible.

exercises.q: She ____ to work in a bank, but now she works in IT.
We didn't ____ to have a car.
I'm not ____ to getting up so early. (used / use)
People ____ to write letters, but now they send messages.
Eu costumava correr todas as manhãs.
exercises.ans: I used to run every morning.

exercises.q: Eu não estou acostumado com o calor.
exercises.ans: I am not used to the heat.

exercises.q: Quando eu era criança, nós costumávamos brincar na rua.
exercises.ans: When I was a child, we used to play in the street.

exercises.q: If I ____ the job, I'll move to Berlin.
exercises.why: After if, use present simple, not will.

exercises.q: If the client ____ the proposal, we will start next week.
Choose the correct sentence:
opts: If it will rain, we stay home.
If it rains, we will stay home.
If it rain, we will stay home.
If it rains, we would stay home.
exercises.why: If + present simple, will + base verb.

exercises.q: We won't finish on time ____ we get more help.
I'll tell you the news when I ____ you.
exercises.why: After when, use present simple for the future.

exercises.q: If you ____ (not/back up) your files, you will lose them.
If the test ____ (fail), the system will send an alert.
I ____ (call) you if I need help.
If she ____ (miss) the flight, she will take the next one.
Se você chegar cedo, eu espero por você.
exercises.ans: If you arrive early, I will wait for you.

exercises.q: Se não chover, vamos à praia.
exercises.ans: If it does not rain, we will go to the beach.

exercises.q: Eu ligo para você assim que terminar o trabalho.
exercises.ans: I will call you as soon as I finish work.

exercises.q: The book ____ I borrowed from you was great.
She is the person ____ I work with.
I know a restaurant ____ they serve great feijoada.
Choose the correct sentence:
opts: The man which called you is my boss.
The man who called you is my boss.
The man who he called you is my boss.
The man whose called you is my boss.
exercises.why: Who replaces the subject; do not repeat it.

exercises.q: He is the developer ____ code broke the build.
The company ____ I work is in São Paulo. (one word)
That's the woman ____ daughter is a pilot. (who / whose)
Everything ____ he said was true. (that / who)
I met a man ____ speaks six languages. (who / which)
A mulher que mora ao lado é professora.
exercises.ans: The woman who lives next door is a teacher.

exercises.q: Este é o computador que eu comprei ontem.
exercises.ans: This is the computer that I bought yesterday.

exercises.q: Eu gosto de pessoas que são honestas.
exercises.ans: I like people who are honest.
